Subject: Sylvan Health site week - need to shift demo?

Hi Vanessa,

Quick heads-up: our clinical ops team just had two people get added to a regional field event the week we planned the onsite demo (site week has moved around). That compresses the window we have on campus to one morning (Nov 15) instead of the full day we originally discussed.

Are you able to:
- Move the session up two days to Nov 13 or 14 (we can be flexible but prefer earlier), OR
- Run the session as a hybrid with a short on-site portion + virtual deep-dive, OR
- Record the walkthrough so we can share it internally with the folks who will miss the live session.

We'd prefer to keep an element of live Q&A - people will be on the road, so a recording is fine as backup. I attached the team's updated itinerary so you can see the constraints.

Apologies for the last-minute shuffle. If you can propose a couple of slots and whether Redwood can do a split in-person/remote flow, that would help us decide fast.

Thanks,
Alex

Hi Alex - thanks for the flag and for sending the itinerary. We can absolutely accommodate a compressed window. Two quick paths that usually work: 

1) Move to an earlier full session (Nov 13 or 14) - we have availability: Nov 13 10:00-11:00 PT or Nov 14 09:00-10:00 PT.

2) Hybrid split on Nov 15: 30-min on-site walkthrough (Marissa can cover the in-person portion) + 30-min remote deep-dive for the broader team. We'll record the remote portion and share the file.

If you prefer the hybrid on Nov 15, we can send a short recorded primer ahead of time (10-12 minute excerpt) to keep the live time focused. I've attached our standard demo deck and a short recording guide so your team knows what to expect.

Propose we lock a path by end of day tomorrow so travel plans can be finalized on your side. If you want, I can loop in Marissa now to confirm travel for on-site coverage.

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck.pdf; demo-recording-guidelines.txt
